'''Thongla Jur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who was a senior member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Jur owned the [[R5-series astromech droid]] [[U9-C4/Legends|U9-C4]], who was a member of [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Thongla.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Thongla Jur concept art]]
Thongla Jur first appeared as a background character in "[[Secret Weapons]]," the tenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, becoming the first Anx to appear in the show. Jur was identified by name in the accompanying episode guide.
